top_story.title: Is AI growth helping markets look past oil and rate hike scares?
top_story.summary: US equities (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are feeling optimistic as the calendar turns to October. But can interest rate hike fears and shocks from rising oil prices (CL=F, BZ=F) stymy growth, or will AI growth continue to drive markets? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Milk Road co-owner Kyle Reidhead, Clocktower Group chief macro strategist Eric Wallerstein, and Washington Crossing Advisors senior portfolio manager Chad Morganlander.
